name: Velocity XL-RG (IO-550 310 hp)
assumptions: Wing span 34 ft, area 132.5 ft2 incl. strakes (F, factory; Jane's 2013-14 gives 31 ft / 102 ft2, which matches the smaller SE: unresolved). Panels and strakes scaled from the CAFE-measured Cozy by span ratio 1.21 (E).
Canard 18.67 ft span, 22.8 ft2 (F). Winglets 2 x 12 ft2 (E).
Fuselage 20 ft (F); width 4.2 ft (47.5 in cabin), height 4.3 ft: E.
Laminar run as the Cozy. Retractable gear: no gear term. Canard carries 20% of the lift (E).
Prop 74 in 3-blade constant speed (E; diameter not found). Published-point weight unstated: 2,600 lb assumed (E).

published.note: GA News 2005 pilot report, factory demonstrator, 75% of 310 hp
